1.1: Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash. bevet avtinas, bevet hannitzotz uvevet hammoked. bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot, veharovim shomrim sham. bet hammoked, kippa, uvayit gadol haya, mukkaf rovadim shel even, vezikne vet av yeshenim sham, umaftechot haazara beyadam. ufirche chehunna ish kisto vaaretz. lo hayu yeshenim bevigde kodesh, ella foshtin umekappelin umannichim otan tachat rashehen, umitkassin bichsut atzman. era keri leachad mehen, yotze veholech lo bammesibba haholechet tachat habbira, vehannerot dolkin mikkan umikkan, ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. umedura hayta sham, uvet kisse shel kavod. veze haya chevodo, metzao naul, yodea sheyyesh sham adam. patuach, yodea sheen sham adam. yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg venitchammem keneged hammedura. ba veyashav lo etzel echav hakkohanim ad shehashshearim niftachim, yotze veholech lo:
1.2: Mi shehu rotze litrom et hammizbeach, mashkim vetovel ad shello yavo hamemunne. vechi veezo shaa hamemunne va. lo chol haittim shavot, peamim shehu va mikriat haggever, o samuch lo millefanav o milleacharav. hamemunne va vedofek alehem, vehem patchu lo. amar lahen, mi shettaval yavo veyafis. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha:
1.3: Natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara, venichnesu acharav ushete avukot shel ur beyadam. venechleku lishte chittot, ellu holchim baachsadra derech hammizrach, veellu holchim baachsadra derech hammaarav. hayu vodkin veholchin ad shemmaggiin limkom bet ose chavittim. higgiu ellu vaellu, amru shalom, hakkol shalom. heemidu ose chavittim laasot chavittim:
1.4: Mi shezzacha litrom et hammizbeach, hu yitrom et hammizbeach, vehem omrim lo, hizzaher shemma tigga bakkeli, ad shettekaddesh yadecha veraglecha min hakkiyyor, vahare hammachta netuna vammiktzoa ben hakkevesh lammizbeach, bemaaravo shel kavesh. en adam nichnas immo, velo ner beyado, ella mehallech leor hammaaracha. lo hayu roin oto velo shomin et kolo, ad sheshshomin kol haetz sheasa ven katin mucheni lakkiyyor, vehen omrim higgia et. kiddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, natal machtat hakkesef veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim helach vehelach, chata min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyarad. higgia laritzfa, hafach panav latztzafon, halach lemizracho shel kevesh keeser ammot. tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe haritzfa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim, mekom shennotnin murot haof vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora:

2.1: Rauhu echav sheyyarad, vehem ratzu uvau. miharu vekiddeshu yedehen veraglehen min hakkiyyor, natlu et hammagrefot veet hatztzinnorot vealu lerosh hammizbeach. haevarin vehappedarin shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, sonkin otam litzdade hammizbeach. im en hatztzedadin machazikin, sodrin otam bassovev al hakkavesh:
2.2: Hechellu maalin baefer al gabbe hattappuach. vetappuach haya veemtza hammizbeach, peamim alav kishlosh meot kor. uvargalim lo hayu medashshenin oto, mippene shehu noy lammizbeach. miyyamav lo nitatztzel hakkohen millehotzi et haddashen:
2.3: Hechellu maalin begizrin lesadder esh hammaaracha. vechi chol haetzim kesherim lammaaracha. hen, kol haetzim kesherin lammaaracha, chutz mishshel zayit veshel gefen. aval beellu regilin, bemurbiyyot shel teena veshel egoz veshel etz shamen:
2.4: Sidder hammaaracha gedola mizracha, vachazitah mizracha, verashe haggizrin happenimiyyim hayu nogim battappuach. verevach haya ven haggizrin, shehayu matztzitin et haalita mishsham:
2.5: Berru mishsham atze teena yafin, lesadder hammaaracha sheniyya lakketoret, mikkeneged keren maaravit deromit, mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot, beomed chamesh seim gechalim, uveshabbat beomed shemonat sein gechalim, sheshsham hayu notnin shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. haevarim vehappedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, machazirin otan lammaaracha. hitztzitu shete hammaarachot baesh, veyardu uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit:

3.1: Amar lahem hamemunne, bou vehafisu, mi shochet, mi zorek, mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, mi medashshen et hammenora, mi maale evarim lakkevesh, harosh veharegel, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete defanot, hakkeravayim, vehassolet, vehachavittim, vehayyayin. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha:
3.2: Amar lahem hamemunne, tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. im higgia, haroe omer, barkay. matya ven shemuel omer, heir pene chol hammizrach. ad shehu vechevron, vehu omer, hen:
3.3: Amar lahem, tzeu vehaviu tale millishkat hattelaim. vahare lishkat hattelaim hayta vemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit. vearba leshachot hayu sham, achat lishkat hattelaim, veachat lishkat hachotamot, veachat lishkat bet hammoked, veachat lishka shehayu osin bah lechem happanim:
3.4: Nichnesu lelishkat hakkelim, vehotziu mishsham tishim ushelosha chele chesef uchele zahav. hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav. af al pi shehu mevukkar mibbaerev, mevakkerin oto leor haavukot:
3.5: Mi shezzacha vattamid, moshcho veholech levet hammitbachayim, umi shezzachu vaevarim holchin acharav. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasin, ureviit shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahen, ushelosha sedarim haya lechol echad veechad, shebbahen tolin. umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:
3.6: Mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora hayu makdimin, vearbaa chelim beyadam, hatteni vehakkuz ushene maftechot. hatteni dome letarkav gadol shel zahav, machazik kabbayin vachetzi. vehakkuz dome lekiton gadol shel zahav. ushene maftechot, echad yored leammat hashshechi veechad poteach kevan:
3.7: Ba lo lappishpash hatztzefoni. ushene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad batztzafon veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam meolam, vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel (yechezkel 44), vayyomer elay Adonai, hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur. natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, nichnas latta, umin hatta el hahechol, ad shehu maggia lashshaar haggadol. higgia lashshaar haggadol, heevir et hanneger veet happotchot ufetacho. lo haya shochet hashshochet, ad sheshshomea kol shaar haggadol shenniftach:
3.8: Miricho hayu shomin kol shaar haggadol shenniftach. miricho hayu shomin kol hammagrefa. miricho hayu shomin kol haetz sheasa ven katin mucheni lakkiyyor. miricho hayu shomin kol gevini karoz. miricho hayu shomin kol hechalil. miricho hayu shomin kol hatztzeltzal. miricho hayu shomin kol hashshir. miricho hayu shomim kol hashshofar. veyesh omrim, af kol shel kohen gadol beshaa shehu mazkir et hashshem beyom hakkippurim. miricho hayu merichim reach pittum hakketoret. amar rabbi eliezer ben diglay, izzim hayu levet abba behar michvar, vehayu mitatteshot mereach pittum hakketoret:
3.9: Mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi, nichnas venatal hatteni vehinnicho lefanav, vehaya chofen venoten letocho, uvaacharona kibbed et hashshear letocho vehinnicho veyatza. mi shezzacha vedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachiyyim dolkim, medashshen et hashshear umanniach et ellu dolkin bimkoman. metzaan shekkavu, medashshenan umadlikan min haddolkim, veachar kach medashshen et hashshear. veeven hayta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot, shealeha hakkohen omed umetiv et hannerot. vehinniach et hakkuz al maala sheniyya veyatza:

4.1: Lo hayu choftin et hattale, ella meakkedin oto. mi shezzachu vaevarim, ochazim bo. vechach hayta akedato, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav. hashshochet, omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, al tabbaat sheniyya. shel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit, al tabbaat sheniyya. shachat hashshochet, vekibbel hamekabbel. ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit, venoten mizracha tzafona. maaravit deromit, venoten maarava daroma. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromit:
4.2: Lo haya shover bo et haregel, ella nokvo mittoch arkubbo vetole vo. haya mafshit veyored ad shehu maggia lechaze. higgia lechaze, chatach et harosh unetano lemi shezzacha vo. chatach et hakkeraayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahen. merak et hahefshet, kara et hallev vehotzi et damo. chatach et hayyadayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahen. ala laregel hayemanit, chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, ushete vetzim immah. kerao, venimtza chullo galuy lefanav. natal et happeder unetano al bet shechitat harosh milmalan. natal et hakkeravayim unetanan lemi shezzacha vahem lahadichan. vehakkeres medichin otah bevet medichin kol tzarkah. vehakkeravayim medichin otan shelosha feamim bemiutah, al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:
4.3: Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved, veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved, velo haya mezizah mimmekomah. nakav et hechaze unetano lemi shezzacha vo. ala laddofen hayemanit, haya chotech veyored ad hashshidra, velo haya nogea bashshidra, ad shehu maggia lishte tzelaot rakkot. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehakkaved teluya vah. ba lo laggera, vehinniach bah shete tzelaot mikkan ushete tzelaot mikkan. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehakkane vehallev veharea teluyim bah. ba lo laddofen hassemalit, vehinniach bah shete tzelaot rakkot milmalan ushete tzelaot rakkot millemattan. vechach haya manniach bachavertah. nimtza manniach bishtehen, shetayim shetayim milmalan ushetayim shetayim millemattan. chatachah unetanah lemi shezzacha vah, vehashshidra immah, vehattechol taluy bah. vehi hayta gedola, ella shel yamin korin gedola, shehakkaved teluya vah. ba lo laoketz, chotcho unetano lemi shezzacha vo, vehaalya veetzba hakkaved ushete chelayot immo. natal regel hassemali unetanah lemi shezzacha vah. nimtzeu chullan omdin beshura vehaevarim beyadam. harishon, barosh uvaregel. harosh bimino, vechotmo chelappe zeroo, vekarnav ben etzbeotav, uvet shechitato milmalan, vehappeder natun aleha. veharegel shel yamin bismolo, uvet oro lachutz. hashsheni, bishte yadayim, shel yamin bimino, shel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashshelishi, baoketz uvaregel. haoketz bimino, vehaalya meduldelet ben etzbeotav, veetzba hakkaved ushete hakkelayot immo. haregel shel semol bismolo, uvet oro lachutz. harvii, bechaze uvaggera. hechaze vimino, vehaggera vismolo, vetzaloteha ven etzbeotav. hachamishi, bishte defanot. shel yamin bimino, veshel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashshishshi, bakkeravayim hannetunim bevazach ucheraayim al gabbehem milmala. hashshevii, bassolet. hashshemini, bachavittin. hatteshii, bayyayin. halchu unetanum mechatzi hakkevesh ulematta bemaaravo, umelachum. veyardu uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit, likrot et shema:

5.1: Amar lahem hamemunne, barchu veracha echat, vehen berchu. karu aseret haddevarim, shema, vehaya im shamoa, vayyomer. berchu et haam shalosh berachot, emet veyatztziv, vaavoda, uvirkat kohanim. uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze:
5.2: Amar lahem, chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu. hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha. chadashim im yeshanim bou vehafisu, mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, hammaale evarim lakkevesh hu maale otan al gabbe hammizbeach:
5.3: Mesarum lachazzanim, hayu mafshitin otam et bigdehem, velo hayu mannichin alehem ella michnasayim bilvad. vechallonot hayu sham, vechatuv alehem tashmishe hakkelim:
5.4: Mi shezzacha vakketoret, haya notel et hakkaf. vehakkaf dome letarkav gadol shel zahav, machazik sheloshet kabbim, vehabbazach haya vetocho, male vegadush ketoret. vechissuy haya lo, uchemin metutelet haya alav milmalan:
5.5: Mi shezzacha vammachta, natal machtat hakkesef, veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim helach vehelach vechata. yarad veeran letoch shel zahav. nitpazzer mimmenna kekav gechalim, vehaya mechabbedan laamma. uveshabbat haya chofe alehen pesachter. ufesachter hayta cheli gadol machazeket letech, ushete sharsherot hayu vah, achat shehu moshech bah veyored, veachat shehu ochez bah milmalan bishvil shello titgalgel. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet, kofin otah al gav gechalim veal hashsheretz beshabbat, umoridin bah et haddeshen meal gabbe hammizbeach:
5.6: Higgiu ben haulam velammizbeach, natal echad et hammagrefa vezorkah ben haulam velammizbeach. en adam shomea kol chavero birushalayim mikkol hammagrefa. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet, kohen sheshshomea et kolah, yodea sheechav hakkohanim nichnasim lehishtachavot, vehu ratz uva. uven levi shehu shomea et kolah, yodea sheechav haleviyyim nichnasim ledabber bashshir, vehu ratz uva. verosh hammaamad haya maamid et hattemeim beshaar hammizrach:

6.1: Hechellu olim bemaalot haulam. mi shezzachu vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora hayu makdimin lifnehem. mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi nichnas, venatal et hatteni vehishtachava veyatza. mi shezzacha vedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachiyyim dolkin, medashshen et hammizrachi, umanniach et hammaaravi dolek, shemmimmennu haya madlik et hammenora ben haarbayim. metzao shekkava, medashsheno umadliko mimmizbach haola. natal et hakkuz mimmaala sheniyya, vehishtachava veyatza:
6.2: Mi shezzacha vammachta, tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe hammizbeach veriddedan beshule hammachta, vehishtachava veyatza:
6.3: Mi shezzacha vakketoret, haya notel et habbazach mittoch hakkaf venotno leohavo o likrovo. nitpazzer mimmennu letocho, notno lo vechafnav. umelammedim oto, heve zahir shemma tatchil lefanecha, shello tikkave. hitchil meradded veyotze. lo haya hammaktir maktir ad shehamemunne omer lo, haketer. im haya chohen gadol, hamemunne omer, ishi chohen gadol, haketer. parshu haam, vehiktir vehishtachava veyatza:

7.1: Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lehishtachavot, shelosha ochazin bo, echad bimino, veechad bismolo, veechad baavanim tovot. vechevan sheshshama hamemunne kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze, higbiah lo et happarochet, nichnas vehishtachava veyatza, venichnesu echav hakkohanim vehishtachavu veyatzau:
7.2: Bau veamdu al maalot haulam. amdu harishonim lidrom achehem hakkohanim, vachamishsha chelim beyadam, hatteni veyad echad, vehakkuz beyad echad, vehammachta veyad echad, vehabbazach beyad echad, vechaf vechissuyah beyad echad. uverchu et haam beracha achat, ella shebbammedina omrim otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha echat. bammikdash hayu omrim et hashshem kichtavo, uvammedina bechinnuyo. bammedina hakkohanim nosim et kappehem, yedehem keneged kitfotehem, uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen, chutz mikkohen gadol sheeno magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer, af kohen gadol magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar (Vayikra 9), vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem:
7.3: Bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaketir, haya ole vakkevesh vehassegan bimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh, achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu. hoshit lo harishon harosh veharegel, vesamach alehen uzerakan. hoshit hashsheni larishon shete hayyadayim, notnan lechohen gadol, vesamach alehen uzerakan. nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo. vechach hayu moshitin lo shear kol haevarin, vehu somech alehen vezorkan. uvizman shehu rotze, hu somech vaacherim zorkin. ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach. mehechan hu matchil, mikkeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. natnu lo yayin lenassech, hassegan omed al hakkeren vehassudarim beyado, ushene chohanim omdim al shulchan hachalavim ushete chatzotzrot shel kesef beyadam, taku veheriu vetaku. bau veamdu etzel ben arza, echad mimino veechad missemolo. shacha lenassech, vehenif hassegan bassudarin, vehikkish ben arza batztzeltzal, vedibberu haleviyyim bashshir. higgiu leferek, taku, vehishtachavu haam. al kol perek, tekia. veal kol tekia, hishtachavaya. ze hu seder hattamid laavodat bet elohenu, yehi ratzon sheyibbane bimhera veyamenu, amen:
7.4: Hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrim bammikdash, bayyom harishon hayu omrim (Tehillim 24:1), laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve vah. bashsheni hayu omrim (sham moach), gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho. bashshelishi hayu omrim (sham 82), elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot. barvii hayu omrim (sham 94), el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia vegomer. bachamishi hayu omrim (sham 81), hareninu lelohim uzzenu, hariu lelohe yaakov. bashshishshi hayu omrim (sham 93), Adonai malach geut lavesh vegomer. beshabbat hayu omrim (sham 92), mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, mizmor shir leatid lavo, leyom shekkullo shabbat menucha lechayye haolamim:
